\documentclass[aspectratio=169,envcountsect]{beamer}
\usetheme{Madrid}
\setbeamertemplate{theorems}[numbered]

\title{Numbered theorem conformance}
\date{}

\newtheorem{proposition}[theorem]{Proposition}
\theoremstyle{definition}
\newtheorem*{remark}{Remark}

\begin{document}

\section{First section}

\begin{frame}{Numbered theorem}
  \begin{theorem}[Named result]
    The first theorem uses the section counter.
  \end{theorem}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Shared theorem counter}
  \begin{proposition}
    A custom declaration can share the theorem counter.
  \end{proposition}
\end{frame}

\section{Second section}

\begin{frame}{Reset and starred declaration}
  \begin{lemma}
    The shared counter resets with the section.
  \end{lemma}

  \begin{remark}
    A starred declaration has no displayed number.
  \end{remark}
\end{frame}

\end{document}
